name: Fall First Fall Endless
source:
Bump into a really handsome stranger! Enjoy delicious ice cream! But this isn't some romance game where you instantly fall in love, right? You'll probably never meet this guy again, so just enjoy the interaction. It's definitely not a meet-cute story, even if one person really wants it to be.

[From [url=https://squidcolas.itch.io/fall-first-fall-endless]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
偶遇一位非常帅气的陌生人！享受美味的冰淇淋吧！但这并不是那种让你立刻坠入爱河的浪漫游戏，对吧？你可能再也见不到这个人了，所以享受这次互动吧。这绝对不是一个邂逅可爱的故事，即使一个人真的想要这样。

[来自[url=https://squidcolas.itch.io/fall-first-fall-endless]itch.io[/url]]
